description: Open a file in the Obsidian app UI. By default fails when the path does not exist; the `failIfMissing` flag controls the open-or-create behavior. Opening an existing file needs read access; opening a missing one creates it, so that case needs write access to the path. A path with no exact match but a single case-insensitive match in its folder opens that file instead and reports the path as sent in `requestedPath`.

failIfMissing.description: When true (default), fails if the file does not exist. When false, allows Obsidian to create the file on open — which requires write access to the path and is rejected in read-only mode.

newLeaf.description: Open in a new leaf (split pane) instead of the active one.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the file to open.

name: obsidian_open_in_ui

createdIfMissing.description: True when the file did not exist before the call and was created by Obsidian.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `path_forbidden`: The path is outside OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS, or — when the file does not exist and `failIfMissing: false` would have Obsidian create it — outside OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS or blocked by OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true. `note_missing`: `failIfMissing: true` (default) and the path does not exist in the vault. Pass `failIfMissing: false` to allow Obsidian to create the file on open. `ambiguous_path`: The parent directory contains multiple files whose names differ only in case (case-sensitive filesystems only). `path_is_directory`: The supplied path names a folder rather than a file. `path_traversal`: The path contains a `.` or `..` segment, which is rejected to prevent vault escape. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Names both paths when a case-insensitive match was opened in place of the requested path.

opened.description: True when the open call succeeded.

path.description: Resolved vault-relative path that was opened.

requestedPath.description: The `path` as sent. Present only when it had no exact match and its single case-insensitive match in the same folder, the output `path`, was opened instead — write and delete tools need the output `path`.

title: Obsidian Open In Ui
